1. Core Economic Engine & Revenue Growth Breakdown

Reddit, Inc. (NYSE: RDDT) operates as an internet forum platform organized around community-driven discussions across specialized subreddits. In an online environment increasingly saturated with synthetic and automated AI-generated content, Reddit’s core value proposition rests on providing unfiltered, authentic human conversation and contextual intent. In Q2 2026, Reddit generated $805 million in total revenue, marking a 61% YoY increase and its eighth consecutive quarter of 60%+ top-line growth. Adjusted EBITDA reached $343 million (a 43% margin, up 106% YoY), net income surged to $253 million (a 31% net margin), and quarterly free cash flow hit $261 million (+135% YoY).

Advertising Revenue ($762 Million, +64% YoY)

Advertising forms the vast majority (94.7%) of Reddit’s revenue engine. Growth during the quarter was fueled by a combination of strong ad pricing realization, impression expansion, and accelerated customer acquisition across mid-market and performance-focused channels:

  • Ad Pricing & Auction Mechanics: Effective ad pricing grew approximately 40% YoY, demonstrating expanding pricing power as advertisers place higher monetary value on high-intent user communities. Ad impressions simultaneously grew 17% YoY.
  • Advertiser Base Scaling: Active advertisers increased by more than 70% YoY, propelled by the adoption of automated campaign management tools. Scaled channel revenues doubled year-over-year as small and mid-sized businesses (SMBs) utilized self-service ad toolkits.
  • Performance & Commerce Ad Formats: Product releases such as Reddit Max (automated campaign optimization), Dynamic Product Ads (DPA), and deep platform integration with Shopify have moved Reddit down the marketing funnel from brand awareness to direct-response commerce conversion.

Data Licensing & Other Revenue ($43 Million, +24% YoY)

Data Licensing and non-advertising revenue totaled $43 million, representing 5.3% of total revenue. While small relative to digital advertising, this higher-margin stream captures the strategic value of Reddit's structured conversational data. Major AI developers pay recurring licensing fees to access Reddit's Data API for real-time model training, post-training alignment, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) search grounding.

Executive Commentary — CEO Steven Huffman on Platform Positioning:
"In an increasingly automated web, the value of real human perspective has never been higher... AI compresses the Internet into summaries. Reddit delivers the opposite: deep discussions, passionate debates, and lived experiences. People do not want a summary of Reddit. They want Reddit."

2. Engagement Dynamics, Monetization Ramp & AI Data Moat

User Dynamics & Engagement Trajectory

Reddit delivered solid engagement expansion globally in Q2 2026, though user growth demonstrated a structural split between mature domestic cohorts and rapidly scaling international markets:

  • Global Scale: Quarterly Daily Active Uniques (DAUq) reached 130.3 million (+18% YoY), while Weekly Active Uniques (WAUq) crossed the half-billion mark to 514.6 million (+24% YoY). The higher growth rate in WAUq vs. DAUq underscores an opportunity to convert casual weekly visitors into daily active users.
  • US vs. International Divergence: US DAUq grew 6% YoY to 53.2 million (nudging down slightly from 53.5 million in Q1 2026), reflecting mature saturation in logged-in domestic users. In contrast, International DAUq surged 28% YoY to 77.1 million, propelled by real-time machine translation rollouts in key non-English geographies.
  • Search Volatility & The "Drive-By" Traffic Pivot: Shifts in external search engine algorithms (e.g., Google AI Overviews and search ranking updates) introduce volatility to top-of-funnel web referral traffic. Management has explicitly addressed this by re-orienting product investments toward direct app engagement and retention rather than relying on search referrals.
Management Strategic Directives — Search Referral Volatility & Native Retention:
"While our visibility in referral traffic remains low, we're not building for drive-by traffic. We're building a daily destination... The direct users, the app users are worth multiples more than search referral traffic." — CEO Steven Huffman

Key Operational Execution: New app-user 1-day and 7-day retention rates improved by ~50% YoY relative to baseline, confirming that direct app onboarding converts low-margin drive-by web traffic into high-margin daily active users.

Monetization Ramp: ARPU Dynamics & Ad Load Expansion

Monetization efficiency accelerated across all geographies, with Global Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) reaching $6.18 (+36% YoY). Growth was driven by substantial expansion in high-yielding US inventory:

Reddit’s monetization strategy rests on two structural vectors:

  1. Ad Load Expansion: Relative to peer social platforms (e.g., Meta's Instagram serving ads every ~3 posts continuously), Reddit maintains lower feed ad density (serving ads approximately every 5–6 posts). This provides substantial organic headroom to increase ad impression volume without harming user experience.
  2. International ARPU Convergence: International users represent 59.2% of DAUq but only 20.7% ($167M) of quarterly revenue. Closing the monetization yield gap through machine translation and localized ad networks represents a key medium-term growth driver.

Strategic AI Data Licensing Moat

Reddit's content repository forms an intellectual property moat within the generative AI ecosystem. Public data licensing agreements with Google (valued at ~$60 million annually) and OpenAI allow these AI models to train on, index, and reference real-time human discussions.

  • Training & Post-Training Grounding: As LLMs risk output contamination from synthetic web content, human conversation, community moderation, and consensus upvoting serve as essential inputs for model reinforcement learning (RLHF) and RAG applications.
  • Non-Commodity Data Rights: Management treats data licensing not as a commodity sale, but as ongoing infrastructure relationships for model training, post-training alignment, and search indexing. This structure establishes high-margin recurring cash flow (91.3% gross margins) while supporting core performance advertising growth.

Because the company relies on third-party cloud infrastructure (primarily Amazon Web Services) rather than owning physical data centers, capital expenditures remain nominal compared to operating cash flow.

#### **Operating Cash Flow vs. Ultra-Low CapEx Breakdown** * **Capital Intensity:** Operating cash flow reached **$262.0M** in Q2 2026 (a 32.5% OCF margin), pushing trailing twelve-month (TTM) operating cash flow above **$1.0B** for the first time. With quarterly CapEx at just **$1.3M**, Reddit converted **99.5%** of its Operating Cash Flow directly into Free Cash Flow ($260.7M). * **Cloud Infrastructure & Fixed Commitments:** The driver behind this low CapEx profile is Reddit’s reliance on public cloud providers. In Q2 2026, Reddit executed an **$880.0M multi-year AWS cloud commitment** spanning July 2026 through June 2029. While this structural expense avoids physical CapEx on balance sheet equipment, it represents a multi-year operational obligation that flows directly through Cost of Revenue. * **Gross Margin Leverage:** Gross margin expanded 50 basis points YoY to **91.3%**. Revenue per employee crossed **$1.0M**. Incremental advertising dollars flow directly down to operating cash flow with minimal physical reinvestment required.
Key Cash Flow Insight: Reddit’s ultra-low CapEx (~$1.3M/quarter) confirms it operates as a capital-light software business. However, investors must evaluate infrastructure costs holistically: cash CapEx is minimized because compute and AI inference expenses are recognized as operating costs via cloud commitments (such as the $880M AWS contract) rather than capitalized asset investments.

Management must spend real corporate cash via share buybacks to offset this equity issuance.

#### **Owner Cash Flow & Buyback Sterilization** 1. **True Owner Cash Flow:** Subtracting Q2 SBC ($106.8M) and physical CapEx ($1.3M) from Operating Cash Flow ($262.0M) yields an adjusted **Owner Cash Flow of $153.9M** for the quarter (~$615M annualized). 2. **Dilution Sterilization:** Reddit deployed **$235M** in cash during Q2 to retire 1.5 million Class A shares at an average price of $157.57. Because buyback cash deployment matched SBC expense, total diluted share count remained flat YoY (<1% net dilution), neutralizing shareholder dilution. 3. **SBC Trajectory:** SBC as a percentage of revenue declined to 13.3% in Q2, down significantly from post-IPO peak levels, aligning with management's goal of scaling revenue faster than equity compensation. ---

Section 5: Intrinsic Valuation & Warren Buffett Owner Earnings Analysis

To establish a realistic, level-headed valuation of Reddit, Inc. (RDDT), we apply Warren Buffett’s intrinsic value framework as articulated throughout his Berkshire Hathaway shareholder letters. Rather than relying on arbitrary exit multiples—which Charlie Munger famously dismissed as assuming a "greater fool" in Year 5—we value the business strictly on the present value of its future net cash flows, treating Stock-Based Compensation (SBC) as an inescapable cash-equivalent cost and strictly isolating maintenance capital expenditures from discretionary expansion.

1. Derivation of Normalized Owner Earnings

Buffett’s 1986 letter defines Owner Earnings as Operating Cash Flow minus Maintenance CapEx, adjusted for real dilution. In Reddit’s high-margin, capital-light digital architecture, physical CapEx requirements are negligible (~0.27% of total revenue). However, stock-based compensation represents a major structural drag on existing shareholders and must be deducted in full.

Buffett Owner Earnings Takeaway: On a trailing twelve-month basis, Reddit generated $1,026 million in operating cash flow. Subtracting $338 million in SBC dilution and $7.5 million in maintenance CapEx yields a Normalized Post-SBC Owner Earnings of $680.5 million. At a market valuation of $30.8 billion (206.4 million diluted shares), Reddit trades at an initial post-SBC Owner Earnings cash yield of 2.21% (or 2.43% on Enterprise Value after accounting for its $2.8 billion net cash balance).

2. 3-to-5 Year Compounding Trajectory & Capital Allocation Framework

  • Discount Rate Grounding: Applying local US sovereign discounting, we utilize the US 10-Year Treasury rate of ~4.20% plus a 5.80% equity risk hurdle, establishing a rigorous 10.0% discount rate.
  • Capital-Light Moat & Working Capital Float: Reddit operates with a 91.5% GAAP gross margin and virtually zero physical reinvestment requirements. Incremental revenue drops directly to cash flow, creating an "expanding bond" effect as digital ad density improves via Reddit Max.
  • Share Buyback Cannibalization: Management authorized a $1.0 billion stock buyback program, executing $235 million in repurchases in Q2. Modeling net share reduction of 1.5% to 2.0% annually, repurchases effectively offset equity grant vestings and shrink the denominator, accelerating per-share cash compounding.
  • Balance Sheet Net Cash Bridge: Reddit carries approximately $2.80 billion in unencumbered cash, equivalents, and short-term Treasuries with zero funded debt obligations. This $13.57 per-share liquidity cushion is added to the discounted present value of future cash flows.

Section 6: Thesis Confidence, Execution Risk & Pre-Mortem Framework

While Reddit’s unit economics reflect world-class operational leverage (crossing $1 million revenue per employee with a Rule of 40 score exceeding 100%), realizing our $185.00 Base Case target requires careful monitoring of structural execution risks and algorithmic headwinds.

1. Execution Risk Assessment

  • Search Engine Referral Volatility: A significant portion of Reddit’s top-of-funnel logged-out traffic relies on Google search algorithm indexing. Changes to Google’s SGE (Search Generative Experience) or core updates introduce traffic choppiness, creating volatility in total Daily Active Uniques (DAUq).
  • US User Stagnation Risk: While overall DAUq expanded 18% YoY to 130.3 million driven by international adoption, domestic US DAUq stagnated sequentially in recent quarters. Because US users generate higher Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) than international users, re-accelerating US engagement is vital to sustain ad yield expansion.
  • AI Data Licensing Renewal Friction: Data licensing agreements with OpenAI and Google represent high-margin non-ad revenue (~$60M–$65M annually). As contracts approach renewal, any partner pushback or pricing compression poses a potential headwind to incremental operating margins.
Pre-Mortem Falsification Triggers (Automatic Thesis Invalidation):

We will immediately lower our intrinsic valuation estimate or exit the position if any of the following three falsification triggers occur:

  1. US Engagement Contraction: US Daily Active Uniques (DAUq) contract by more than 5.0% year-over-year for two consecutive quarters, signaling core saturation or algorithmic displacement.
  2. SBC Expense Erosion: Stock-based compensation re-accelerates above 35% of revenue, eroding post-SBC Owner Earnings margins below 20.0%.
  3. AI Licensing Impairment: Tier-1 AI data licensing renewals occur at haircuts greater than 25.0% relative to initial contract run-rates, or key partners fail to renew.
